title: How do you make a camera travel inside an object in an AI video?
description: The camera passes through the sapphire crystal and settles among the gears in one unbroken shot — driven by two pinned frames, not by a described camera move.

faq.q: Can AI video do an impossible camera move, like passing through solid glass?
faq.a: Yes, and it is easier than describing it. Pin a hero exterior as start_image and an extreme macro interior as end_image; the model solves the path between them. Scale change and material transitions come free because both endpoints are fixed.

faq.q: What do you describe in the prompt once both frames are locked?
faq.a: Motion and light only — constant forward momentum, how highlights behave as you cross the material boundary, and the audio. Composition is already settled by the two images.
